As Apple Computer (AAPL) Market Valuation Declined, Shareholder Stonebridge Capital Advisors Decreased Position; Blackrock Cl A (BLK) Stock Value Rose While Chemical Bank Boosted Its Stake
April 30, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Chemical Bank increased its stake in Blackrock Inc Cl A (BLK) by 23.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Chemical Bank bought 869 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.90% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 4,636 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.38M, up from 3,767 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Chemical Bank who had been investing in Blackrock Inc Cl A for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $84.80B market cap company. The stock increased 0.22% or $1.14 during the last trading session, reaching $525.79. About 119,478 shares traded. BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE:BLK) has risen 41.90% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 30.35% the S&P500.
Stonebridge Capital Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Apple Computer Inc (AAPL) by 2.51% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 122,740 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $20.77M, down from 125,903 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stonebridge Capital Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Computer Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $838.95 billion market cap company.
